title: Superb day with teenagers!
text: We had an amazing time with Rigo on this bike tour. Traveling with teenagers, it is sometimes difficult to know if they are having a good time but this tour was a winner! We had a lovely Day in Sevilla and on bikes, the city was easy to see. We had the perfect blend of information and excitement. The tapas were good, not excellent but the rest of the day was outstanding. The tour operator even waited for us since we did not know that The hub of Sevilla was closed for the holidays to cars by the police. Would definitely recommend to a friend!
author: Yohana_C

title: Fun local tapas experience
text: We had an amazing experience with centerbici! We cycled trough the city with our tour guide who guided us to three different ‘local’ tapasbars/ restaurants. We had fun concersations with our guide and enjoyed real good tapas. I Would definately recommend this tour!
author: Manon V

title: Perfect combination of culture and pleasure
text: Our guide, Ambra, showed us the main places in Sevilla on bike. A perfect mix of culture and relaxing with food and drinks. She took us to 3 local bars that serve delicious tapas. We learned a lot about the typical Spanish drinks and dishes.
author: Master_T-1972
